===== /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-btl-hardening.conf =====
# ============================================================
# BTL - Secured Network Service Configuration
# Generated file. Do not edit by hand.
# Target: Ubuntu / OpenSSH server, port 22
# ============================================================

### Listener ###
Port 22
ListenAddress 0.0.0.0

### Who may log in ###
# Only members of the listed groups may establish a session.
PermitRootLogin no
PermitEmptyPasswords no
UsePAM yes
AllowGroups sshusers

### Authentication ###
# Public key only. Password and keyboard-interactive are refused so
# that a stolen passphrase cannot be used from an unexpected host.
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
GSSAPIAuthentication no
HostbasedAuthentication no
PermitUserEnvironment no

### Brute force resistance ###
MaxAuthTries 3
LoginGraceTime 30
MaxSessions 10
MaxStartups 10:30:60

### Forwarding and tunnelling are disabled ###
# None of these are needed for SCP/SFTP file transfer and each one
# is a way for a user to reach hosts they should not reach.
X11Forwarding no
AllowAgentForwarding no
AllowTcpForwarding no
PermitTunnel no
GatewayPorts no
StreamLocalBindMask 0077

### Session hygiene ###
ClientAliveInterval 300
ClientAliveCountMax 2
TCPKeepAlive yes
PrintMotd no
PrintLastLog yes
AcceptEnv LANG LC_*
SetEnv PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
Banner /etc/ssh/banner.txt

### Crypto policy ###
Ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com,aes256-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes128-ctr
MACs hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-512,hmac-sha2-256
KexAlgorithms curve25519-sha256,curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,ecdh-sha2-nistp256,ecdh-sha2-nistp384,ecdh-sha2-nistp521,diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha256
HostKeyAlgorithms ssh-ed25519,ecdsa-sha2-nistp256,ecdsa-sha2-nistp384,ecdsa-sha2-nistp521,rsa-sha2-512,rsa-sha2-256

### Logging ###
SyslogFacility AUTH
LogLevel VERBOSE

===== /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-btl-sftp.conf =====
### SFTP only accounts, jailed into their own directory ###
# These accounts cannot open a shell; they can only transfer files
# and they cannot see anything outside of their jail.

Match User ftpsvc
    ChrootDirectory /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc
    ForceCommand internal-sftp -d /upload
    AllowTcpForwarding no
    X11Forwarding no
    PermitTTY no
    GatewayPorts no

Match all

===== /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/btl-sshd.local =====
# ============================================================
# BTL - fail2ban configuration
# Generated file. Do not edit by hand.
# ============================================================

[DEFAULT]
bantime  = 1h
findtime = 10m
maxretry = 3
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1
# Repeated offenders get an ever longer ban, capped at one week.
bantime.increment = true
bantime.factor    = 1
bantime.maxtime   = 1w
backend = systemd

[sshd]
enabled  = true
port     = 22
maxretry = 3
# 'aggressive' also catches scanners that connect but never
# attempt to authenticate.
mode     = aggressive
backend  = systemd

[recidive]
enabled  = true
bantime  = 1w
findtime = 1d

===== /etc/audit/rules.d/50-btl.rules =====
# ============================================================
# BTL - auditd rules
# Generated file. Do not edit by hand.
# ============================================================

## SSH configuration changes ##
-w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k btl_sshd_config

## SSH key material ##

## Privilege escalation configuration ##
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k btl_sudoers
-w /etc/sudoers.d -p wa -k btl_sudoers

## User and group databases ##
-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k btl_identity
-w /etc/group -p wa -k btl_identity
-w /etc/shadow -p wa -k btl_identity

## SFTP jail configuration ##
-w /opt/sftp-jails -p wa -k btl_sftp_jail

## Commands executed as root ##
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -F euid=0 -S execve -k btl_root_commands

## The sshd binary itself must not be replaced ##
-w /usr/sbin/sshd -p x -k btl_sshd_exec

===== /etc/ssh/banner.txt =====
This system is restricted to authorised users.
All connections are logged and monitored.
Misuse of this system is a criminal offence.

===== admin accounts =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# BTL - create the SSH administrator accounts.
set -euo pipefail

if ! getent group sshusers >/dev/null; then
    groupadd sshusers
    echo 'created group sshusers'
fi

# Keep the provisioning account (tuananh) able to log in.
usermod -aG sshusers tuananh 2>/dev/null || true

if ! id -u btladmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    adduser --disabled-password --gecos '' btladmin
    echo 'created user btladmin'
fi
usermod -aG sshusers btladmin

# The accounts must not be able to log in with a password.
for user in btladmin; do
    passwd -l "$user" || true
done

# Install the public keys for btladmin.
home_dir=$(getent passwd btladmin | cut -d: -f6)
mkdir -p "$home_dir/.ssh"
chmod 700 "$home_dir/.ssh"
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIDncPehI/a1/UOzlzYVs19nJIGw1xB3XtSlWp8lrSePa btl-admin@BTL-workstation' >> "$home_dir/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chown -R btladmin:btladmin "$home_dir/.ssh"
chmod 600 "$home_dir/.ssh/authorized_keys"
echo 'installed 1 key(s) for btladmin'

# Install the public keys for tuananh.
home_dir=$(getent passwd tuananh | cut -d: -f6)
mkdir -p "$home_dir/.ssh"
chmod 700 "$home_dir/.ssh"
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIDncPehI/a1/UOzlzYVs19nJIGw1xB3XtSlWp8lrSePa btl-admin@BTL-workstation' >> "$home_dir/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chown -R tuananh:tuananh "$home_dir/.ssh"
chmod 600 "$home_dir/.ssh/authorized_keys"
echo 'installed 1 key(s) for tuananh'

===== sftp accounts =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# BTL - create the jailed SFTP-only accounts.
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /opt/sftp-jails

if ! id -u ftpsvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    adduser --disabled-password --gecos '' ftpsvc
    echo 'created user ftpsvc'
fi

usermod -aG sshusers ftpsvc

mkdir -p /home/ftpsvc /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc/upload

# The jail root must be owned by root and not writable by
# anyone else, otherwise chroot() could be escaped.
chown root:root /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc
chmod 755 /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc

# Only the upload directory belongs to the account.
chown ftpsvc:ftpsvc /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc/upload
chmod 700 /opt/sftp-jails/ftpsvc/upload

# The home directory has to exist for the account to start a
# session, but it is not part of the jail.
chown ftpsvc:ftpsvc /home/ftpsvc
chmod 750 /home/ftpsvc

mkdir -p /home/ftpsvc/.ssh
chmod 700 /home/ftpsvc/.ssh
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGKMvX3mhYQG30Oatszqz8uQ8yan4vsqsAGDGLpTPiPs btl-sftp@BTL-workstation' >> /home/ftpsvc/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown -R ftpsvc:ftpsvc /home/ftpsvc/.ssh
chmod 600 /home/ftpsvc/.ssh/authorized_keys
passwd -l ftpsvc || true
echo 'installed 1 key(s) for ftpsvc'
